items.question: Who is LuckDate?
items.answer: LuckDate is a youthful wellness brand built around everyday management — not just supplements, but a complete system. We combine science-led products (including Fitoo meal replacement and NMN vitality support), a smart tracking app, and nutritionist guidance to help adults stay lighter, more active, and more consistent over time. Our philosophy is simple: staying young is about how light, active, and consistent you feel in daily life.

items.question: What products does LuckDate offer?
items.answer: LuckDate focuses on two core solution lines plus supporting formulas. Fitoo Meal Replacement Powder supports light body management, meal rhythm, and calorie-aware routines. NMN Vitality Support is designed for long-term youthful wellness, energy, and cellular vitality. Additional LuckDate supplements may support digestion, detox, energy, and skin health as part of a broader daily routine. Products are meant to work together with the LuckDate app and nutritionist support — not as isolated purchases.

items.question: Who should use LuckDate products?
items.answer: LuckDate is designed for adults who want practical support for weight goals, daily energy, and long-term vitality — especially people who feel motivated but struggle to stay consistent alone. It is ideal for busy professionals, parents, and wellness-minded adults who want a structured routine rather than a one-time quick fix. LuckDate is for people ready to eat smarter, track progress, and communicate with support — not for those seeking a miracle cure without lifestyle effort.

items.question: What problems does LuckDate help solve?
items.answer: LuckDate addresses the gap between wanting results and maintaining consistency. Many people fail not because they do not care, but because they lack structure. LuckDate helps with: irregular meals and portion control (Fitoo), low energy and long-term vitality concerns (NMN and related formulas), lack of accountability (app tracking), and uncertainty about what to adjust next (nutritionist check-ins). The goal is a lighter everyday body feeling and sustainable youthful wellness — not extreme short-term dieting.

items.question: What are the main ingredients?
items.answer: Key ingredients vary by product, but LuckDate formulas emphasize high-quality, purposeful ingredients selected for daily wellness support. Fitoo meal replacement typically includes balanced macronutrients, fiber, and vitamins/minerals to support meal substitution and calorie-aware routines. NMN Vitality Support centers on NMN (Nicotinamide Mononucleotide) as a NAD+ precursor, often combined with complementary nutrients that support cellular energy and antioxidant pathways. Other LuckDate products may include probiotics, botanical extracts, omega fatty acids, or targeted actives depending on the formula. Always review the full Supplement Facts label on each product for the exact ingredient list and amounts.

items.question: How do the ingredients work?
items.answer: LuckDate ingredients are chosen to support everyday wellness goals through practical biological pathways. Fitoo helps replace a meal with structured nutrition — supporting portion control, meal timing, and a lighter daily routine when paired with tracking. NMN supports NAD+ levels, which are involved in cellular energy production and metabolic processes associated with healthy aging. Probiotics and botanical ingredients in other formulas may support digestion, antioxidant balance, or skin wellness depending on the product. LuckDate is designed for consistent daily use so these supports can compound over time — not for instant overnight transformation.

items.question: How is LuckDate different from other supplement brands?
items.answer: Most brands sell a bottle and leave you on your own. LuckDate is a system: Product + App + Nutritionist Support. You get effective formulas (Fitoo, NMN, and more), app-based tracking for meals, weight, habits, and reminders, plus nutritionist guidance for practical adjustments. LuckDate also emphasizes science-led credibility — including authorized endorsement from Aaron, a 2004 Nobel Prize laureate in Chemistry, and quality standards supported by FDA-registered manufacturing and GMP practices. The difference is consistency support, not just another product on a shelf.

items.question: What situations is LuckDate best for?
items.answer: LuckDate fits modern routines where structure matters: replacing a rushed breakfast or lunch with Fitoo, supporting a weight goal before an event or season, building a post-40 wellness routine, maintaining energy during busy work weeks, or adding long-term vitality support alongside healthy habits. The daily ritual is simple — Eat/Take, Record in the app, Communicate with your nutritionist, and Get Results through consistency. It works best when integrated into real life: home, office, travel, and everyday meal rhythms.

items.question: What precautions should I know?
items.answer: LuckDate products are dietary supplements and wellness support tools — not medicines and not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Results vary by individual and depend on consistent use, diet, sleep, and activity. Do not use LuckDate products as a sole source of nutrition unless a product is specifically designed and labeled for meal replacement. Consult your healthcare provider before use if you are pregnant, nursing, under 18, taking medication, or managing a medical condition. Follow label directions, store products properly, and discontinue use if you experience an adverse reaction. LuckDate supports healthy aging and daily wellness — not medical treatment.

items.question: Is there scientific support behind LuckDate?
items.answer: Yes — LuckDate is built on a science-led wellness philosophy. NMN is widely studied in the context of NAD+ and cellular energy pathways. Fitoo and other formulas use thoughtfully selected ingredients at purposeful levels for daily support. LuckDate highlights authorized endorsement from Aaron, 2004 Nobel Prize laureate in Chemistry, and manufactures in facilities that follow FDA registration and GMP quality practices. Certificates and science content are available in our Journal & Guides and About sections. While supplements are not FDA-approved drugs, LuckDate prioritizes credible science communication, quality manufacturing, and transparent ingredient information.

what.title: What Are Cookies?
what.p1: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, provide analytics information to site owners, and deliver a better browsing experience.
what.p2: This Cookie Policy explains how LUCKDATE ("we," "us," or "our") uses cookies and similar technologies on our website.

essential.label: Essential Cookies
essential.text: These cookies are strictly necessary for the operation of our website. They enable core functionalities such as page navigation, access to secure areas, and shopping cart functionality. The website cannot function properly without these cookies.

performance.label: Performance Cookies
performance.text: These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website — such as which pages are visited most often and whether users encounter error messages. This data helps us improve the performance and usability of our site.

functional.label: Functional Cookies
functional.text: These cookies allow our website to remember choices you make (such as your language preference or region) and provide enhanced, personalized features. They may also be used to remember changes you made to text size, fonts, and other customizable elements.

marketing.label: Marketing Cookies
marketing.text: These cookies track your browsing activity across websites to deliver advertisements that are more relevant to you and your interests. They also limit the number of times you see an ad and help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.

items.text: to enable sharing features and track campaign performance

thirdParty.note: These third parties may use cookies to collect information about your online activities over time and across different websites.

managing.title: Managing Your Cookies
managing.desc: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can manage your cookie preferences in the following ways:
managing.browserDesc: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can set your browser to block or alert you about cookies, or to delete cookies that have already been set. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

retention.title: Cookie Retention
retention.desc: The length of time a cookie will stay on your device depends on whether it is a "session" or "persistent" cookie:

items.label: Session Cookies
items.text: Temporary cookies that are deleted when you close your browser.

items.label: Persistent Cookies
items.text: Cookies that remain on your device for a set period or until you manually delete them. Our persistent cookies are retained for no longer than 12 months.
